study_scope: Same 16 PREVIOUSLY SEEN WikiText TRAIN prompts / 656 teacher-forced gold tokens, DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat original27 native MLX Metal. NOT independent testing.

independent_audit.bootstrap_type: shared 16-sentence cluster percentile resampling 20,000 draws on previously observed TRAIN16

scientific_interpretation.observation: Three exact-byte mixed A/B/C policies have higher true NLL than original AF4 in previously inspected TRAIN16. Role-output SSE gain ranks A>B/C, but this proxy does not supply parameter NLL Fisher.
scientific_interpretation.conditional_hypothesis: The compound early Q4-to-AF4 / late AF4-to-Q4 switches in B/C failed to recover original NLL. This cannot isolate the causal harm of early vs late role changes.
scientific_interpretation.uncertainty: TRAIN16 cluster bootstrap bounds are conditional to observed 16 sentences, not a prospective generalization CI.

next_preregistered_gradient_gate.target: True per-token gradient of original27 log probability in a 48-dimensional categorical tier interpolation around baseline original AF4. 24 roles x {Q4,Q5} candidate difference vectors; no direct weight-Hessian claim.
next_preregistered_gradient_gate.required_differentiable_coordinates: alpha_{r,tier} multiplies (dequantize(W_{r,tier})-dequantize(W_{r,AF4})), all 48 coordinates initially 0. Q4 and Q5 are mutually exclusive for each role. Preserve E64 original path.
next_preregistered_gradient_gate.required_per_token_score: s_(token,r,tier)=partial log p_original27(y_token|context,alpha)/partial alpha_{r,tier}|alpha=0, differentiating through all affected downstream layers and full NLL, not through FFN output MSE
next_preregistered_gradient_gate.empirical_fisher_definition: F_jk = (1/N) * sum_token s_token,j*s_token,k; 48x48 PSD by construction; do not substitute (mean score)^2
next_preregistered_gradient_gate.quadratic_risk_proxy: DeltaNLL_hat(x) = g^T x + 0.5*x^T F x; F is a Gauss-Newton/Fisher surrogate, not automatically equal the Hessian or exact NLL increase; cross-role interactions must be retained
next_preregistered_gradient_gate.bit_budget_constraints: 24 categorical AF4/Q4/Q5 roles; enforce exact 12 AF4,6 Q4,6 Q5 and 43,253,760 physical bytes; only one tier per role
autochecks: Exact original27 OFF gold NLL and output SHA parity

Sixteen-sentence diagnostic A/B/C cannot be used for adopting or fine-tuning hyperparameters
